text:
maria: Bootstrapping BOS GPU cluster today, network bring-up in progress. TGW attachment created from core transit, need someone to validate routing, NAT autoscale, and DNS delegation before we handoff to oncall. tagging @liam @anika. high-level checklist: 1) routes propagated to private subnets, 2) NAT gateway pool healthy and can scale, 3) outbound egress IPs are in allowlist for partner feeds, 4) private zone delegation to core-dns. :rocket:

liam: I can take routes + TGW. TGW attachment id: tgw-attach-0a1b2c3d. Pulled route table for private subnet-1:```RouteTableId: rtb-0f1e2d3c
0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-07xx (propagated)
10.0.0.0/16 -> local
203.0.113.0/24 -> tgw-rt-123 (to core)``` Looks fine, but I see a static route for 203.0.113.0/24 — is that expected?

maria: yes, 203.0.113.0/24 is partner egress we tunnel via TGW to core peering for partner routing. Need to confirm NAT source IPs match partner allowlist.

anika: checking NAT autoscale group and egress IP table. NAT is using managed NAT gateway with elastic IP pool: eip-0aa, eip-0bb, eip-0cc. Autoscale target healthy_count=2 -> current 2, scale-policy looks good. Also verifying NACLs/security groups: workers SG allows outbound 80/443 and ephemeral TCP high ports. NACLs are stateless but allow ephemeral range 1024-65535 outbound.

ryan: running quick egress test from a worker pod (kubectl exec into test pod):```$ curl -sS https://ifconfig.me
203.0.113.45``` That matches partner IP range (203.0.113.0/24). Also ran curl to S3 signed url -> 200.

net-bot: TGW attachment tgw-attach-0a1b2c3d status -> available :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: route-propagation job finished for rtb-0f1e2d3c, 3 routes propagated.

liam: ok routes + TGW good. Two items: 1) route priority for partner CIDR must remain before default route to NAT to prevent hairpin, 2) we should lock down the transit policy to only accept partner prefixes. I'll open a quick ACL change if needed.

maria: noted. anika, can you confirm DNS delegation? We created private zone bos.internal.redwood and added NS records in core-dns.

anika: I pushed NS records to core-dns via terraform:```resource "aws_route53_record" "bos_ns" {
  zone_id = "ZCORE123"
  name    = "bos.internal.redwood"
  type    = "NS"
  ttl     = 300
  records = ["ns-1.core.redwood.", "ns-2.core.redwood."]
}``` Did a dig:```$ dig +short ns.bos.internal.redwood
ns-1.core.redwood.
ns-2.core.redwood.``` Core resolvers are returning records.

ryan: DNS resolution from cluster:```$ nslookup api.bos.internal.redwood 10.0.0.2
Server: 10.0.0.2
Address: 10.0.0.2#53
Name: api.bos.internal.redwood
Address: 10.0.10.12``` Good.

maria: sweet. One more: cost guardrails. BOS burst GPU pool default instance type is p4d. We want to ensure autoscaler uses spot first with on-demand fallback. Who owns the capacity config?

liam: infra-autoscale team owns it. Current config in k8s nodepool: spotPreferred: true, onDemandFallback: true, maxSurge: 5. I'll confirm cloud provider quotas for p4d in BOS region — requesting increase already (req-12345).

anika: also adding firewall egress monitor to alert if egress IPs change (partner acceptlist). Will create a lambda check that runs every 5 mins to compare current eips vs expected and page if mismatch.

maria: please attach runbook snippets for handoff. minimal acceptance: routes validated, NAT scale ok, DNS delegated, egress IPs match, TGW attachment available, cost config in place. Once all checks green, I'll mark handoff to eng-oncall.

ryan: quick sanity smoke from k8s to core services: curl internal endpoints, metrics come back. all green. :thumbsup:

liam: I'm going to add a route rule change to prevent accidental route precedence changes and add a tag on the static partner route: tag:owner=net-team, tag:immutable=true. Doing now.

liam: update: tagged rtb route, and added transit policy rule to only accept 203.0.113.0/24 from partner ASN.

deploy-bot: terraform apply for dns+route tags completed. plan: 3 to add, 1 to change.

maria: outstanding items left?

anika: creating egress-ip-monitor lambda + alerting. ETA 2 hours.

liam: cloud quota request pending approval, but current capacity enough for initial bring-up.

ryan: I'll run one more full e2e smoke in 30m and post results.

maria: ok team — if you have no more blockers, I'm going to mark this cluster as network-ready and handoff to eng-oncall at 1976543284. please ack here. :eyes:

liam: ack.

anika: ack.

ryan: ack.

maria: handoff complete. tagging @eng-oncall. :tada:
